description: Switches the turntable plug off once the Vinyl ADC ripper has been idle for 5 minutes (the side ended, or the turntable was left on). Not while the Calibrate view or a bench test holds the recorder (hold_s > 0), and only after the plug itself has been on for 5 minutes. Source: vinyl-adc/integrations/turntable-auto-off.json

conditions.value_template: {{ is_state('sensor.vinyl_ripper','idle') and (state_attr('sensor.vinyl_ripper','hold_s') | int(0)) == 0 and now() - states.sensor.vinyl_ripper.last_changed > timedelta(minutes=5) and now() - states.switch.turntable.last_changed > timedelta(minutes=5) }}
